meta.title: Paper Trading Execution Test Harness
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create an end-to-end test harness for paper trading execution to validate strategy execution, order fills, and position tracking via the PaperBroker.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Test harness executes trading strategies in paper trading mode via PaperBroker
Order fills simulated with configurable fill models (immediate, delayed)
Positions tracked accurately (entry price, size, direction)
PnL calculations match expected values with Decimal precision
Order state transitions follow expected lifecycle (pending → submitted → filled/cancelled)
Tests cover both long and short positions with various scenarios

key-tasks.task: Implement deterministic TestStrategy class with known signals
Implement fill model tests (immediate and delayed)
Implement position tracking tests (long/short, entry price, size)
Implement PnL calculation tests with Decimal precision
Implement order lifecycle tests (state transitions, logging)
Create comprehensive test scenarios (profit/loss for long/short)

architecture-context.pattern: Immediate model: Fill at current simulated price within same tick Delayed model: Fill after configurable delay (default 100ms)
architecture-context.constraint: Paper trading overhead must be less than 10ms vs live path (NFR3)
Paper trading must produce deterministic results (NFR11)

technical-specifications.spec: Long: unrealized_pnl = (current_price - entry_price) * position_size Short: unrealized_pnl = (entry_price - current_price) * abs(position_size)

dependencies.dependency: Epic 10.1 must be complete (audit findings resolved)

nfr-references.nfr: All order state transitions logged for audit
Paper trading must produce deterministic results
